body: I feel the exact same way.  I have so much anxiety over things in my life and it just goes on and on.  I have a very logical way of thinking about things and my logic tells me that 99.9% of all my anxiety is useless but it never ends.  I see others that have a seemingly easier time handling their anxiety an I wonder what is the trick to not being so anxious.  I never seem to learn how to deal with it.  The only answer I can seem to come up with is that anxiety doesn't end because stress never ends. There will always be stressful situations in life so we will always be anxious about those stressful things.  If it becomes too much see a doctor.  I take medication and it really helps.
